profile.description:
Riding Warehouse proudly serves the three main disciplines of equestrian sport: English, Western, and Endurance. No matter the discipline, putting you and your horse first is the essence of who we are. Located in San Luis Obispo on California's Central Coast, Riding Warehouse offers a huge selection of products for horse and rider including tack, saddles, riding apparel, stable equipment and horse care supplies.

The entire service crew at Riding Warehouse rides!  This ensures a wide range of horse knowledge and product savvy to cater to each customer's varied equestrian needs. Combined with an unbeatable one-year free return policy, carefully selected products, and educational how-to's, Riding Warehouse is an equestrian resource that cannot be beat!  

We look forward to serving you and sharing our love of horses. Happy riding!
